basis: inventory.mjs; AST identifiers excluding comments/strings and function definitions; production vs #[cfg(test)]/mod tests separated; frontend string references split production / test / src/demo; generate_handler registrations and cfg recorded separately
limitation: Conservative name-based references (command names are treated as globally unique), not type resolution or a complete dynamic-call proof. The inventory frontend column only recognizes literal invoke() calls, so commands wrapped by helpers can appear as frontend "none" while still referenced. No command may be declared dead without cfg/internal-call review and coordinator approval.
